text:
[issue by OutOfOrderCandy]
### Minecraft Version

1.21.1

### Mod Loader

Fabric

### Describe the Issue

Version that is casing an issue : waystones-fabric-1.21.1-21.1.37.jar

Balm version : balm-fabric-1.21.1-21.0.63

Fabric API : 0.116.14
Cobblemon : 1.7.3

If you try to use waystones while riding a pokemon, this leaves traces of the pokemon and sometimes causing crashes to server.

https://imgur.com/a/mR9y5hl

It works fine on version before 21.1.37

### Logs

[crash-2026-07-18_17.40.27-server.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30160941/crash-2026-07-18_17.40.27-server.txt)

Should be fixed in 21.1.38

It has been fixed. Thanks!
